from pathlib import Path

path = Path("src/aspenops_nexus/models.py")
text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")


def replace_once(old: str, new: str) -> None:
    global text
    count = text.count(old)
    if count != 1:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Expected one patch target, found {count}: {old[:120]!r}")
    text = text.replace(old, new, 1)


replace_once(
    "from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field\n",
    "from copy import deepcopy\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\n",
)
replace_once(
    '''    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)
''',
    '''    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "ok": self.ok,
            "communication_ok": self.communication_ok,
            "engine_ok": self.engine_ok,
            "converged": self.converged,
            "feasible": self.feasible,
            "values": deepcopy(self.values),
            "units": dict(self.units),
            "violations": list(self.violations),
            "diagnostics": deepcopy(self.diagnostics),
            "elapsed_s": self.elapsed_s,
            "balance_residuals": deepcopy(self.balance_residuals),
            "cache_source": self.cache_source,
            "cache_hit": self.cache_hit,
            "request_hash": self.request_hash,
            "worker_id": self.worker_id,
        }
''',
)
if "asdict(" in text:
    raise RuntimeError("Unexpected dataclasses.asdict usage remains in models.py")
path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
